resources.string: Big clock, date, a month calendar and, when music plays, a compact player — in the style of iPhone StandBy. Black OLED background with burn-in protection.

While the phone charges, keeps a dim clock on screen (desk-clock style) in both orientations. It never blocks normal use — a tap, the power/home button, waking the phone or picking it up returns you to the normal screen; it re-appears on the next charge session.
The “display over other apps” permission is required.
Also use as the system screen saver
Android only auto-starts a screen saver when idle and charging on some devices. If yours does, pick “AlwaysON StandBy” as the screen saver in the settings it opens.
To show the player card for music from any app, Android needs “Notification access” for AlwaysON. Tap to open the system list, then turn AlwaysON on.
Active — keeps the clock on while charging

There is no public Android API to draw while the screen is fully off (that is the manufacturer AOD). This app uses the closest supported options: an overlay that, while the phone charges, keeps a dim clock on screen in either orientation and hands the phone back on tap / power / home / wake / pick-up, plus the system screen saver where the firmware honours it. The now-playing card only appears while music actually plays.
